---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new check for odflens
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What accessibility gap or workflow pain are you hitting? Describe the ODT, ODS,
or ODP content that odflens does not currently handle. Note the relevant
EN 301 549 or WCAG requirement where you can.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like odflens to do. If you are proposing a new rule, sketch the
check and the failure it should report, and say which of ODT, ODS, or ODP it
applies to.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
